definitions.short: Arad , the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite
definitions.full: H6166. Arad [ עָרַג ] verb long for (compare Arabic ascend , II. bend, incline toward (); high, elevated ; Ethiopic ascend ; Late Hebrew עֲרוּגָה = Biblical Hebrew); — Qal Imperfect 3feminine singular תַּעֲרֹג Psa 42:2 (of stag, with עַל of thing in simile); with אֶל , of longing for God 42:2 (subject נַפְשִׁי ), so תַּעֲרוֺג Joel 1:20 (of beasts, craving water). I. עֲרָד proper name, of a location Canaanite city in the Negeb , Αραδ (Egyptian ±a-ru-dâ WMM As.u.Eur.168, 170 ); — Judg 1:16 , ׳מֶלֶחעֿ Num 21:1 (JE) = 33:40 , Josh 12:14 (D, Α ( ι ) ραθ , A ᵐ5 L Αδερ ); probably modern Tel Arad , 16 2-Janmiles south of Hebron; compare GFM Judg 1:16 Buhl Geogr. 182 . II. עֲרָד proper name, masculine Benjamite 1Chr 8:15 , Ωρηρ , A Αρωδ , ᵐ5 L Αραδ .
